Messages.Author: Ralf Lammert
Messages.Body:
Hello,

reading the spoiler list of AH (still having NO AH-cards) some
question about B2W occured to me ...
Can you play MULTIPLE B2W in _one_ turn? IMHO you can
because it`s no strike and there are no rules preventing
you from playing multiple copies of this card. You can
"Flash" more than once per turn if neccessary ..
Bye,
Ralf

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <326AD1...@ece.jcu.edu.au>,
brett <4mc...@ece.jcu.edu.au> wrote:
>Does blood to water burn Vampires?

No.

>Or does it go like this:

>Inferior
>
>Not usable first round. If apposing minion is Ally then the Ally loses 3
>blood or is burned.

>Superior
>
>Not useable first round. If apposing minion is a Vampire than the
>vampire loses 5 blood.
>
>Is this correct?

Alas, no.

B2W works like this:

IF
(opposing minion is ally)
THEN
(ally is burned)
ELSE
(burn 3 blood if at regular, 5 if at superior)
ENDIF

dig?

gomi

On Oct 21, 1996 12:25:58 in article <Re: Blood2Water Question>, 'brett

It goes like this:

Inferior:
Not usable first round. If opposing minion is a Vamipire, it loses
3 blood. If opposing minion is not a Vampire (e.g. an Ally) that Ally
is burnt.

Superior:
Same, but 5 blood.
